title: Credential Profile UI for Microsoft Graph API Mail Server Does Not Match Figma Design
description:
In the newly added Mail Server support for the Microsoft Graph API, the Credential Profile UI does not match the provided Figma design.

Issues Observed:
 * UI alignments are inconsistent with the Figma design.
 * The Grant Type dropdown options do not match the expected values specified in the design.

Expected Result:
 * The Credential Profile UI should match the provided Figma design in terms of layout, spacing, and alignment.
 * The Grant Type dropdown should display the correct options as defined in the Figma design.

Actual Result:
 * UI alignment differs from the Figma specification.
 * Grant Type dropdown contains incorrect or mismatched options.

Reference:
 * Figma: [https://www.figma.com/proto/DPReGBjeIv7nogzeNs9Uel/Settings?type=design&node-id=2610-47977&viewport=18254%2C31001%2C0.5&t=cyc29zVvo6ifgJMp-1&scaling=scale-down-width&starting-point-node-id=632%3A36804&page-id=0%3A1&content-scaling=fixed]
